CLEAVER.description: A heavy butcher knife intended to hack through tough bone, such as in the preparation of meat. Faster swing time.
CLEAVER.name: CLEAVER

ENTRENCHER.description: A perfect tool for flying soldiers.Model by Victor.
ENTRENCHER.name: ENTRENCHER

STREITER.description:
The power of god and anime is on your side.
Mass produced carbon sword with minimal design to optimize results. The quick stab is a simple punch, don't question why it's as powerful as the blade swings!
Model by Vic.
STREITER.name: STREITER

TANZANITE BLADE.description: A truly retro sword crafted from jewels. Great for knocking out giant green exploding monsters. Halloween 2020 Melee.
TANZANITE BLADE.name: TANZANITE BLADE

GOSPELL BLADE.description:
Blade of the chapel in the northen keep, forged from the laughing skull explosive and thick ice, held together through elven magic. The blade is used to slay those who fight against the teachings of the cold god.
Model by Microsushi.
GOSPELL BLADE.name: GOSPELL BLADE

HAVOC BLADE.description:
An exotic blade that only the most seasoned of soldier can wield properly. Large blade, large damage.
A reward for sticking with us for so long, thank you.
Model by ILLAXIS.
HAVOC BLADE.name: HAVOC BLADE

TANTO.description: Despite how it looks, it's actually classified as a short sword. Originally used as weapons they slowly became more of a mantle piece than for actual combat.
TANTO.name: TANTO

DARKHEART.description:
Scepter born of evil. Blade of night that only appears when you swing it. It's power is immense but it's unwieldy to use. Can your mortal form even handle it?
Halloween 2020 Melee.
Model by Vic + Mako.
DARKHEART.name: DARKHEART

JKEY.description:
A special reward for your participation in the 2018 Ready Player One event. Very short range with fast swing time.
... Escape your past and the key will be yours at last.
JKEY.name: JKEY

TRENCH KNIFE.description: A classic Grand Federation blade used in the second world war. The blades were easy to break so the weapon was also made with knuckles in case of those situations.
TRENCH KNIFE.name: TRENCH KNIFE

KRAMPUS KUKRI.description:
A blade forged from black ice, tempered with the fires of hate from a vengeful christmas spirit.
Does the most damage striking at the heart.
Holiday 2020 Melee made by ILLAXIS.
KRAMPUS KUKRI.name: KRAMPUS KUKRI

COOKIE CUTTER.description:
If a Gingerbread man is inside of a Gingerbread house, would the house be made out of flesh or might the Gingerbread man be made out of home?

MERRY CHRISTMAS EVERYONE! (2023)
COOKIE CUTTER.name: COOKIE CUTTER

KUNAI.description: Find your ninja way and defeat your foes. These were utilized by ninjas in ancient times both as close combat weapons as well as throwing knives. Sadly your training only allows the former. Short range, quick attacks. Believe it!
KUNAI.name: KUNAI

RITUAL SICKLE.description:
An elaborate but crudely made sacrificial sickle weapon used by the cultists as both a self defense weapon... and for horrible rituals.
Original model by Poodros.
Halloween 2020 Melee.
RITUAL SICKLE.name: RITUAL SICKLE

BALISONG.description: A modern incarnation of a classic Maharlikan knife, known for its use for tricks and just overall looking cool. Got any tricks to share?
BALISONG.name: BALISONG

LINKED SWORD.description:
The classic, the original.
Basic attacks are quick slashes with short range. Alt attacks are thrusts with great range but long cooldown.
LINKED SWORD.name: LINKED SWORD

ICE PICK.description:
A pick designed for cutting into packed ice, useful for scaling cliffs and glaciers alike. It might have been used by a free man once, in another timeline. Longer range.
Model by Shay.
ICE PICK.name: ICE PICK

UTILITY KNIFE.description:
A Helzevia army knife with many useful tools one could flip out for any number of situations.
Tiny blade, fast speed.
Halloween 2020 Melee.
UTILITY KNIFE.name: UTILITY KNIFE

TOON BLADE.description:
It's dangerous to go alone! Not sure how much a toy sword will help, but take it anyway?
April Fools 2024 melee.

Model by Duo.
TOON BLADE.name: TOON BLADE

HRUNTING.description:
Pronounced 'Runting'.
An ancient english blade spewing with venomous fire, does the most damage to the heart.
Model by Darkman_Bree.
HRUNTING.name: HRUNTING

CUTTER.description:
It's pizza time.
Small cutting instrument with a rotating circular blade making it perfect for cutting pizza, people though are harder to cut.
Does the best damage against arms and legs. Made by Darkman_Bree.
CUTTER.name: CUTTER

MACHETE.description:
A Zarovian machete intended for the taiga. A certain GRU agent might have used this very style of machete. Longer range.
A chain is only as strong as its weakest link.
MACHETE.name: MACHETE

TOMAHAWK.description:
A small axe useful for surviving in the wilderness, even after your plane goes down. Maybe it's time you bury the hatchet with your opponent. Fast swing time with shorter range.
Model by Shay.
TOMAHAWK.name: TOMAHAWK

MEK'LETH.description:
A strangely shaped melee weapon, made out of a tough alloy. While it may be cumbersome for a human, a particularly strong alien could make great use of this. Longer range.
Qaplaʼ!
MEK'LETH.name: MEK'LETH

KNIFE.description: A Grand Federation bayonet knife, with many purposes. Essentially the baseline for all melees.
KNIFE.name: KNIFE

KEY.description: Wait, are these your keys? House keys, car keys, closet keys, basement keys... WHOSE KEYS ARE THESE AND WHAT DO THEY OPEN?!
KEY.name: KEY

KARAMBIT R.description:
A sharply curved Indonesian knife, popular as both a utility and combat knife. Very short range with high damage.
Remodel by ILLAXIS.
KARAMBIT R.name: KARAMBIT R

ICICLE.description: A cursed spike of ice that will extend out when the user desires it to. Use it to freezze the cold heart of scrooges.
ICICLE.name: ICICLE

BRIDAL BRANDISHER.description:
A rapier bathed in the blood of a father murderer.
Great reach, great power. Requires patience to master.
Model by Shelby.
BRIDAL BRANDISHER.name: BRIDAL BRANDISHER

WAR FAN.description: A traditional fan hiding a deadly blade, quick to move and slice, especially deadly towards the head.
WAR FAN.name: WAR FAN

JASON.description:
A traditional machete with a lot of history and more than its fair share of combat. All you need now is a hockey mask. Functionally identical to the Machete.
Chh-chh-chh, ahh-ahh-ahh...
JASON.name: JASON

CLASSIC KNIFE.description: Wow, you really made it past rank 200? You're awesome, thank you so much from the StyLiS dev team for playing and supporting our game for so long.
CLASSIC KNIFE.name: CLASSIC KNIFE

KAMA.description:
A traditionally Asian farming tool used for reaping crops and the blood of your enemies.
Model by Shelby.
KAMA.name: KAMA

NATA HATCHET.description: A multipurpose hatchet useful for pruning small bushes and debarking trees. The accursed blade sings gently like the higurashi, carrying on its tune the curse of a girl who turned her back on her friends as she was overcome by madness. It remains possessed by that fragment of misery to this day.
NATA HATCHET.name: NATA HATCHET

HUNTING KNIFE.description:
A classic hunting knife made with modern materials. It feels perfectly weighted in your hand. Trades some range and swing speed for damage.
What's your favorite scary movie?
HUNTING KNIFE.name: HUNTING KNIFE

KOMMANDO.description:
The cool guy's blade.
The M48 Kommando is too radical to be used by any current military force, banned across many army competitive scenes for being too overpowerful.
If you own one, you (don't) own the world.
KOMMANDO.name: KOMMANDO

TACTICAL SPATULA.description: This spatula can open bottles, help you fry eggs, and dice watermelons in a single swing. Slightly faster swing time.
TACTICAL SPATULA.name: TACTICAL SPATULA
